meanings.definition: (Present participle / Gerund) To make the sound of water hitting a hot surface.; (Present participle / Gerund) To be exciting or dazzling.
examples: The song sizzled with energy.
The sausages were sizzling on the barbecue.
I sizzled the bacon for a few minutes in the pan.

meanings.definition: Hot enough to make a hissing sound.; Brought to the table in the metal dish it has been cooked in, making such a sound.
examples: The two teams played a sizzling match.
He stood by the window, sizzling quietly as the light faded into evening.
They observed the fountain sizzling clear water high into the morning air.

meanings.definition: Such a hissing sound.; (Present participle / Gerund) The sound of water hitting a hot surface
examples: We heard the sizzling of the onions hitting the pan.

meanings.definition: (Past tense & participle) To insert (a graft) in a branch or stem of another tree; to propagate by insertion in another stock; also, to insert a graft upon.; (Past tense & participle) To insert scions (grafts) from one tree, or kind of tree, etc., into another; to practice grafting.
